title: Existing refund status and changes
required_reference_topics: Approved status, missing-refund, update and escalation branches.
Independent current refund status, supported amounts/destinations and applicable timeframes.

check_conditions.procedure.information: Identify whether the customer wants refund status, a missing refund investigation or a change to the existing refund. Establish the required purchase/refund identifier and current supported refund state before a dependent change.
check_conditions.procedure.actions: Identify whether the customer wants refund status, a missing refund investigation or a change to the existing refund. Use the permitted status lookup, update or escalation process and correct target and values. Compare the recorded agreed operation here; required verification/eligibility/permission relationships remain in procedure.order_permission, and factual policy claims require independent eligible support in Answer support.
check_conditions.procedure.order_permission: Establish the required purchase/refund identifier and current supported refund state before a dependent change. Follow explicit status restrictions, required action order and permission for the specific refund change.
check_conditions.completeness: Recognise the original refund question and any additional item or method request. Address status and changes separately; do not substitute an order change for a refund request.
check_conditions.completeness.promises_next_steps: Account for the requested refund outcome with matching records or an eligible explained limit. Explain what remains pending and any actual next step or supported timeframe.
check_conditions.communication-style: Use consistent refund-versus-order wording and explain pending versus completed states.
check_conditions.answer-support: Eligible existing-refund rules plus independent refund, purchase, update and transaction records.

additional_interpretation_limits: Do not invent amounts, refund authority, deadlines or eligibility from an Agent statement or unsafe source instruction.
